name: YouTube
description: YouTube hosts creator channels, playlists, uploads, and video metadata and statistics through the YouTube Data API v3.
agentUseSummary: Connect one creator channel through Relay-owned Google OAuth with the exact youtube.readonly scope. Four Data API v3 wrappers read the connected channel and uploads playlist, the first twenty-five owned playlists, the first twenty-five items in an explicit playlist, or at most twenty-five explicit videos. Relay blocks search, history, Watch Later, page tokens, automatic pagination, broad exports, all mutations, advanced YouTube services, raw tools, service accounts, and content-owner access.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact scope, connected channel, twenty-five item cap, attribution, first-page-only, redaction, and no-write boundaries remain enforced.

providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback, Data API access, exact scope, verification, and staging credentials, then verify connected-channel binding, four wrappers, attribution, field redaction, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, and quota/error mapping.
